title: Sales Manager, EMEA
description:

Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create and automate content the way their business works. Accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

We're scaling fast and we need someone who can build a sales team that scales with us.

This is a role for a leader who gets things done, someone who can coach a team of Account Executives to consistently hit targets, build a disciplined outbound motion from the ground up, and bring real rigour to pipeline and forecasting. Not someone who manages from a dashboard. Someone who's in it with the team.

You'll own new logo growth. That means hunter mentality, structured process, and the ability to spot when something's going wrong before it shows up in the numbers.

 

What you'll do

- Leading and coaching a team of AEs across EMEA - setting clear expectations, holding the bar high, and giving people what they need to succeed across multiple markets and time zones

- Building and strengthening our outbound motion across the region - prospecting, pipeline coverage, and moving deals through the funnel with consistency, whether the buyer is in London, Munich, or Stockholm

- Keeping the business honest on forecasting - monitoring conversion metrics and intervening early when pipeline coverage looks shaky

- Working closely with Marketing and Enablement to align on pipeline strategy, sharpen messaging for EMEA buyers, and get the team the right tools

- Feeding customer and market insights from across the region back to leadership to shape our go-to-market thinking

 

ABOUT YOU

You've managed Enterprise AEs before, ideally with exposure to more than one European market, and you know what good looks like. You've seen structured sales orgs at scale and you've worked in fast-moving environments where you had to figure things out as you went - including the reality of running a team spread across different countries, cultures, and buying norms. You're direct, execution-oriented, and you genuinely enjoy building the systems that make a team predictable.

You set a high bar - but you know that hitting targets consistently is about clarity and process, not just pressure.

- You'll need:

- Previous experience managing AEs in B2B SaaS or tech, with experience selling or managing across EMEA markets

- Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing sales talent across different countries and cultures

- A track record of building structured outbound pipeline processes that actually stick, in a distributed regional team

- Strong forecasting discipline and a history of hitting quota

- Comfort managing a team distributed across multiple time zones

- The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment

- Background in developer tools, content platforms, or product-led growth combined with enterprise sales

- Fluent English; an additional European language (German, French, or similar) is a plus

Sanity.io http://Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. What You’ll Work On
FIX Onboarding & Integrations

• Lead and manage FIX client onboarding projects - from initial requirements gathering through certification and production go-live.

• Configure, test, and validate FIX sessions, including order routing, execution reporting, and market data flows.

• Coordinate conformance testing and certification with clients to ensure compliance with platform standards.

• Understanding of financial market structure and post-trade work

Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

Abridge is embedded in 250+ health systems and expanding rapidly across the federal healthcare ecosystem. The Federal program is one of the most consequential and complex programs in the company, spanning clinical deployment, enterprise IT, government contracting, product integration, and policy. This role owns the success of the program at large.

The Program Director is the operational center of gravity for the federal program. You are responsible for the overall health and forward momentum of key federal partnerships - and for ensuring that every team touching the program is rowing in the same direction. At the heart of this role is a genuine commitment to the mission: improving the lives of clinicians and the patients they serve. That mission is not a backdrop; it is the lens through which strategy is set, trade-offs are made, and progress is measured.

You hold the picture across commercial, product, clinical, engineering, legal, and government affairs, and are accountable for driving alignment, surfacing risk, and ensuring the right people are working on the right things at the right time. You translate strategy into execution, create clarity where there is ambiguity, and serve as the connective tissue that keeps a complex, multi-stakeholder program moving with purpose.

This is a role for someone who has run complex programs before and knows the difference between keeping a tracker current and actually moving a program. You will have a lot of surface area to cover and not a lot of hand-holding. You will need to evolve operating rhythms as the program matures, earn trust with senior internal and external stakeholders, and be the person who knows where everything stands.

This role reports to the Head of Partner Success.

What You’ll Do
Mission-driven leadership and cross-functional alignment
Ensure that every internal team contributing to the federal program - product, clinical, commercial, engineering, legal, and government affairs - understands the strategy, is aligned on goals, and is working in a unified direction. Ground cross-functional priorities in the mission to serve clinicians and patients, and hold that mission as the north star when navigating trade-offs, resolving friction, or making day-to-day decisions. Create the clarity teams need to execute with confidence, and proactively resolve misalignment before it becomes drag.

Program operations and rhythm
Design and run the operating cadence for the federal program, including weekly cross-functional syncs, dependency tracking, quarterly planning cycles, and exec-level reporting. Maintain the single source of truth on strategy, delivery status, outcomes, and goals - ensuring the full team has a shared understanding of what we are working toward, where we stand, and what needs to change. Translate program status into clear, action-oriented communication for internal leadership and federal stakeholder

• Experience in e commerce, DTC, or consumer products - multi channel revenue recognition is a plus.

title: Head of People & Performance
description:
OUR MISSION:

At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost.

OUR VISION:

We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future.

The role

We are hiring our first Head of People & Performance.

You report to the CEO and sit on the leadership team. You own how we hire, how we set the bar, how we review performance, pay and promote, and how we part ways. You also own the platform underneath: contracts, onboarding, HRIS and compliance across more than 10 European countries.

We have doubled the team in the last 9 months to 50 people today and expect to continue growing the team on a similar trajectory. The job is to build the people system that scales with that.

This is primarily a builder's role. Build lean - sharp systems, a small set of trusted partners, and automation for the transactional work. Grow the People team only when necessary.

We are outcome-driven, direct, high trust and high autonomy organization. There is very little hand-holding. We enjoy working with people that bring a healthy degree of intensity and drive.

 

What you will do

- Own performance
Design one performance cycle for the whole company and run the first one. Every leader should be able to tell you and the CEO who is above the bar, who is on it, and who is below, and act on it within days.

- Own the employee experience
Build what it is like to work at Sunrise from the first day to last.

- Own compensation and levels
Build comp bands for today's roles, not a framework for roles we don't have yet. Hang them off a light leveling structure. Standardize pay awards and equity top-ups, so every hiring manager can make a defensible offer inside the system.

- Own how we hire
Manage our internal recruiting, embedded recruiting partners, and the hiring managers' process. Standardize scorecards and interview packs. A role does not open without one. You are not the recruiter, but you own the system the recruiters run in.

- Own people operations end-to-end
Contracts, onboarding, offboarding, HRIS, employer of record, policies, benefits by country, payroll inputs. Automate whatever can be automated. From signed offer to laptop on desk, no manual steps.

- Coach
Coach our leadership and team leads on people and performance: setting expectations, giving direct feedback, running hard conversations, acting early.

- Codify our culture
Talent and culture are upstream of everything else. The founders write it down. You turn it into how we hire, review and reward, and you act decisively when someone does not live it.

- Keep us compliant across more than 10 countries
Employment structure, ISO documentation. Own the framework that decides where and how we employ the best talent.

Who you are

- You have built this before
Somewhere, a fast-growing company runs on a people system you built. You may have been the first people hired at a Series A that grew past 100, the number two in a people function at a larger scale-up, or an operator who did it from a consulting, operations, or venture seat without the title. We care about the work, not the title.

title: Principal Identity Engineer
description:
What are we building?
Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.
Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?
What's the Position?
Identity is the control plane of modern security. In a Zero Trust world, every access decision - for every employee, every administrator, and every machine - flows through the identity systems you will own. We're looking for a Principal Identity Engineer to be the technical authority on how Hard Rock Digital decides who (and what) can access which systems, when, and under what conditions.
This is a deliberately senior, high-trust role - one of three Principal openings reporting directly to our VP Security / CISO - because identity is not a slice of our security program; it is the backbone the rest of it is built on.
You'll be our first dedicated identity hire, inside a 16-person security organization spanning Security Operations, Risk Management, and Architecture & Engineering. Day-to-day provisioning and helpdesk sit with our IT team; your job is architecture, automation, and governance that make access safe.
If you think in terms of blast radius, least privilege, and phishing-resistant authentication - and you like owning a domain end to end rather than a corner of it - you'll feel at home here.
What You'll Do
Identity & Access Architecture

• Own the security architecture, standards, authentication methods, and roadmap for Microsoft Entra ID, our primary identity provider - partnering with IT on tenant operations

• Design and continuously refine Conditional Access policies that balance strong protection with a smooth experience for a globally distributed workforce

• Advance our rollout of phishing-resistant, passwordless authentication (passkeys, certificate-based, FIDO2)

• Own federation and single sign-on across our SaaS estate (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM provisioning)

Privileged & Just-in-Time Access

• Own our privileged access model using Microsoft Entra PIM - separate admin identities, just-in-time elevation, and approval workflows

title: Discovery Call Specialist
description:
Modern Thyroid Clinic is the leading thyroid specialty healthcare provider in the United States. For over ten years, we have helped patients - most of them women navigating long, difficult health journeys - finally get answers and feel like themselves again, earning well over 600 five-star reviews across multiple platforms.

The Discovery Call Specialist is the first human voice prospective patients meet. This person conducts complimentary discovery calls (held via Zoom) with individuals who have reached out to learn more about our care. The goal of these calls is not to enroll people; it is to listen, build trust, answer questions clearly, provide reassurance, and help each person determine whether Modern Thyroid Clinic is the right fit for them. When it is the right fit, the Specialist warmly invites the prospective patient to begin their care.

This role requires high empathy, a kind and gentle demeanor, strong communication skills, and the ability to guide a meaningful conversation with purpose and care - never pressure.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct complimentary discovery calls with prospective patients over Zoom, with the camera on.

• Listen first and create a safe, supportive space in which each person feels seen, heard, and respected.

• Build trust through warmth, patience, and genuine care.

• Clearly explain how telehealth care works, what it costs, what to expect, and what makes our providers different.

• Provide reassurance to individuals making a vulnerable, important decision about their health.

• Guide each conversation toward the right outcome for the patient - helping them find their best fit, even when that fit is not with us.

• For prospective patients for whom our care is right, warmly invite them to begin care with the clinic.

• Apply a consultative, question-led approach to onboarding that builds confidence rather than applying pressure.

• Represent the mission, values, and culture of Modern Thyroid Clinic in every interaction.

Required Qualifications

•
Prior relevant experience conducting discovery calls and/or helping patients or clients make positive, confident decisions about their care or wellbeing. (Candidates without this experience will not be considered.)

•
Prior experience in consultative onboarding - a question-led, trust-based approach to guiding people through a decision.

• Excellent verbal communication skills; articulate, warm, and clear.

• Comfortable and polished showing up for work on Zoom with the camera on .

• High empathy and the emotional maturity to hold space for someone's fears and hopes with grace.

• Ability to connect easily with people who are struggling, particularly women navigating difficult health journeys.

• Must be able to work full-time, 40 hours per week (this is not a part-time role).

• Must be authorized to work in the United States and able to be verified for employment through E-Verify .

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with a consultative, question-led sales or decision-guidance philosophy, such as the approach taught by Jeremy Miner.

• A personal connection to health challenges. (Many of our team members and clinicians were once patients themselves. A thyroid condition - or any condition - is not required.)

Work Schedule & Arrangement

• Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday .

•
Moderately flexible scheduling within standard business operations.

• Fully remote / telehealth.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a professional, distraction-free environment suitable for video calls are required.

What We Offer

Modern Thyroid Clinic is a culture-first company. We treat each other with respect - no pettiness, no gossip - and we actively support, train, and develop our team. Our average employee tenure exceeds five years, with team members who have been with us since our earliest days. For many of us, this is more than a job; it is a mission we believe in because we have seen the results firsthand.

description:
Overview
At Wipfli , people count.
At Wipfli , our people are core to everything we do-the catalyst behind our ability to create exceptional impact and extraordinary results.

Job Summary: Under the direction of Finance leadership, the Director, Billing & Collections provides enterprise leadership for billing operations, accounts receivable collections and the Finance components of the Lead-to-Cash value stream. The Director is accountable for creating a scalable operating model that improves realization, billing quality, cash conversion, transparency and the partner and client experience. This role leads day-to-day operating performance while partnering across Growth, Practice, Operations, ED&T, ERP and Finance to redesign processes, strengthen controls, establish decision rights, improve data and reporting, and deliver workflow and automation capabilities. The Director leads onshore and offshore teams, develops talent and service standards, and serves as the senior Finance owner for billing and collections transformation.
Responsibilities
Essential Responsibilities:

• Provides enterprise leadership for billing and collections operations, establishing clear ownership, service standards, calendars, escalation paths and performance expectations across the full operating cycle.

• Leads the Finance workstreams within the Lead-to-Cash program and partners with executive sponsors, business owners, technology owners and program leaders to align scope, priorities, milestones, dependencies and measurable outcomes.

• Designs and implements a scalable billing operating model with a standard control core and configurable workflows appropriate for recurring, fixed-fee, milestone, time-and-materials, subscription/product and transaction-based revenue.

• Owns strategies to reduce aged WIP and AR, accelerate invoicing and collections, improve DSO and cash conversion, and increase accountability for unresolved balances, disputes and promised payments.

• Establishes governance for WIP adjustments, transfers, write-offs, write-downs, out-of-scope work, invoice approvals, holds, project closure and third-party collection referrals.

• Partners with Practice and engagement leaders to clarify billing roles and decision rights among REs, PBSs, analysts, billers, collections and Finance, with emphasis on billing quality and client experience.

• Defines the minimum commercial, engagement and project data required for effective billing, including scope, fee, rate, milestone, cadence, contact, purchase-order and exception information.

• Partners with ED&T, ERP, data and architecture teams to establish business requirements for workflow, dashboards, structured data, client/project identity, integrations, automation and AI-enabled capabilities.

• Provides business leadership for vendor discovery and implementation, ensuring that solution selection follows approved process design, architecture, controls, data requirements and measurable benefit expectations.

• Builds and governs a billing and collections scorecard covering WIP aging, WIP addressed, billing cycle time, realization, write-offs, AR aging, disputes, DSO, cash conversion and other measures.

• Ensures reliable management reporting, data definitions, monthly tie-outs, exception reporting and action-oriented review cadences for Finance and executive leadership.

• Leads root-cause analysis of billing delays, rework, leakage, write-offs, collection failures and recurring exceptions, translating findings into process, policy, data, training and system improvements.

• Develops the onshore/offshore operating model, capacity plan, role design, training curriculum, quality-review approach and succession plan for billing and collections

title: Customer Success Manager

Customer Success Manager

Scaled Success · India Development Center · Remote, India

ServiceChannel is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facilities management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage, and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. Well established yet still driven by the spirit of a startup even after 27 years, we are on a high-growth trajectory and committed to building a great product for our customers and an extraordinary work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally.

Position Summary

We are building a team of Customer Success Managers in our India Development Center to support our scaled customer segment through a one-to-many, digital-led success model. As part of a team of Customer Success Managers, you will help steward a shared portfolio of roughly 300 smaller customers (about 70 accounts each) and drive product adoption, retention, and measurable value at scale. The role blends the consultative instincts of a traditional Customer Success Manager with the efficiency of scaled and digital engagement: repeatable success plays, curated digital touchpoints, and data-informed outreach that reach many customers without sacrificing quality. It suits a strategic problem solver and an organized doer who thrives on a high-volume book, works well independently across time zones, and takes pride in helping customers get the most from their technology.

Key Responsibilities

• Own a portfolio of roughly 70 smaller customers, driving adoption, retention, and value through a mix of one-to-one and one-to-many engagement, including digital campaigns, group webinars, office hours, in-app guidance, and curated success plays.

• Proactively recommend ServiceChannel standard methodologies, processes, and configurations that align with each customer's business objectives and drive full adoption of ServiceChannel's product offering across the customer lifecycle.

• Run repeatable, scalable success motions such as onboarding assists, adoption checkpoints, health reviews, and renewal-readiness outreach, tuned to the needs of a high-volume book.

• Monitor customer health signals and product usage to identify churn risk and expansion opportunities, triaging at-risk accounts and escalating when needed.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Strong judgment around tradeoffs involving latency, reliability, capacity, and cost.

- Experience taking ownership of complex infrastructure from architecture through production operation.

description:
The client is a health benefits platform serving individuals, families, and small businesses across all 50 states. The company acts as its own search engine, broker, and third-party administrator, offering Major Medical insurance and healthshare memberships alongside a consultative approach built around transparency and finding members the right plan at the right price.
We are hiring a Senior Process Engineer to extend our process engineering capability, not just our execution capacity. This is a genuinely autonomous role: you'll be pointed at a business area (claims, billing, enrollment, customer experience) and own the full cycle: diagnose, design using Six Sigma/Lean methodology, implement, and prove the result with a number.
You'll report directly to our EVP of Operations, a Six Sigma Black Belt himself, and work the same way, with the same toolkit, on real operational problems with real budget and real visibility.
What this role is not

• Not a role where someone else has already scoped the fix; you find root cause yourself

• Not a people-management role at the outset (though scope expands as trust and results build)

• Not a call center, inbound support, or scheduling role

Why this role
Real ownership of funded, meaningful projects, not a documentation or facilitation-only seat. A direct line to an EVP who applies Six Sigma at the executive level, and a clear path for scope to expand as trust builds.
Responsibilities
What independence actually means here
This is the single most important requirement, more important than certification level:

• You find and engage the right stakeholders yourself. No contact list handed to you.

• You diagnose the true root cause, not the symptom that got reported.

• You design the fix using DMAIC, 5 Whys, fishbone, process mapping, and validate it before you build.

• You implement it yourself, coordinating everyone across the company needed to make it real.

• You're given a target, not a detailed brief, and you're expected to produce a working result.

If you've only ever executed someone else's pre-scoped plan or facilitated someone else's workshop, this isn't the right seat. If you've independently run RCA and driven a fix from diagnosis through adoption, this is built for you.
What you'll actually own in the first 90 days
Five concurrent workstreams: two with a design already scoped for you to build (onboarding/communications rollout, proactive claims-status communication), and three where you diagnose from scratch (a full CX manual-process audit, a claims call-volume root-cause deep dive, and an open enrollment risk assessment). Yes, that's an aggressive load for a first 90 days; we say so directly, and there's a built-in Day 30 checkpoint to re-sequence honestly based on real velocity. We're not looking for someone who needs that spelled out in more detail than a target and a deadline.
Requirements

• Six Sigma Black Belt strongly preferred (Lean Six Sigma Black Belt a plus); candidates with equivalent independent RCA/DMAIC leadership experience are encouraged to apply

• 8+ years in process improvement, industrial engineering, or business operations

• A track record of independently leading RCA/DMAIC projects from diagnosis through implementation, not facilitating someone else's plan

• Strong process mapping and documentation skills (Visio, Lucidchart, or similar)

• Excellent written and spoken English; you'll present directly to U.S.-based leadership

• Full availability across U.S. Central Time business hours

• Healthcare, insurance, or benefits experience is a plus, not a requirement; strong business/digital/remote-work experience is an acceptable substitute

There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. THE OPPORTUNITY

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.

THE ROLE

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

- Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

- Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

- Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

The environment is highly iterative and performance-driven, with a strong emphasis on reliability, correctness, and real-world usability, not just demos.

• Design and deploy LLM-powered systems for document understanding, drafting, and workflow automation

• Build and orchestrate agent-based systems (e.g., LangChain / Deep Agents) for complex, multi-step tasks

• Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, reliability, and regressions

• Implement data pipelines for ingesting and structuring documents (including OCR workflows)

• Improve system performance through prompt design, retrieval strategies, and tool integration

• Work closely with product and engineering to translate legal workflows into AI-native systems

• Debug and optimize long-running agent jobs and failure modes in production

• Contribute to overall AI architecture, including memory, context management, and retrieval layers

Qualifications

• 3-7 years of engineering experience, or a strong track record building and shipping AI systems (excluding internships)

• Proficiency in TypeScript and experience building production backend systems

• Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain) and agent architectures

• Experience designing and running evals (benchmarks, test sets, regression tracking)

• Familiarity with document processing pipelines, including OCR and unstructured data extraction

• Strong understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval (RAG), and tool-augmented generation

• Ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and own systems end-to-end

• Startup or high-velocity experience preferred

description:
Job Description:
The Critical Maintenance Technician (CMT) is responsible for responding to and resolving all facilities building maintenance requests. Critical maintenance tasks may include, but are not limited to: plumbing, mechanical, heating, air-conditioning (HVAC), and general maintenance to support the site needs, as required. This position will also provide escorting for contractors providing services in the building and the data center, as requested.
 
Location: Lytle, TX
 
Qualifications:
RESPONSIBILITIES
Answer and respond to all mechanical, electrical, and plumbing-related calls from customers, contractors, and management. Address and correct issues promptly, and properly communicate any on-going or severe issues to the appropriate chain of command
Record all maintenance tasks via the appropriate system, resolve tickets in the system when work is complete

Assist with the development, revision, and execution preventive maintenance procedures, and perform quality control reviews to ensure accuracy, clarity, and continual improvement
Order parts, as needed, to support building maintenance needs, and maintain required documents and record of inventory
Assist with planning and coordination of all large-scale projects required to address building issues
Maintain accurate building data including, rounds, PM work orders, change management, etc.
Manage assigned workflow tasks in order to provide timely turnaround
Escort and work effectively with outside contractors, ensure they are abiding by critical facility work rules
Complete facility rounds at the beginning of each shift to ensure building and grounds upkeep

Adhere to all federal, state, and local safety laws

High school degree or GED, preferred
Two years working experience in facility maintenance
Basic understanding of electrical, plumbing and carpentry, required

SigmaSight is the insurer-side answer to EvenUp Law-the unicorn reshaping settlements plaintiff-side. We’re building an AI-powered operating system for insurer negotiation, transforming how carriers evaluate, value, and resolve claims.

• Represent SigmaSight in client discussions-confidently holding your own with defense counsel while earning their trust.

• Confident communicator-able to interact with insurer leadership and defense counsel diplomatically and persuasively.

• Comfortable leveraging AI and structured tools to enhance analysis and writing.

• Process-minded operator who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment.

title: Environmental Compliance Technician
description:
Factor a brand of HelloFresh is seeking an Environmental Compliance Technician. The Environmental Compliance Technician proactively monitors and enforces adherence to company policy and procedures for the proper disposal of food and waste within the production and surrounding areas for all employees. This role takes a frontline hands on approach to training employees in real time, while eliminating risk to the components that may damage company property or public infrastructure. This role will be reliant on building strong partnerships with all personnel on the production floor. Additionally, this position will require the gathering of data in order to report out trends and high risk areas regarding the proper disposal of food waste to the leadership teams. This role is responsible for anticipating possible risks and violations to the food waste process and addressing them in real time with a solution based coaching type of approach.  The Environmental Compliance Technician is responsible for following and enforcing all safety, GMP and SQF policies/procedures, as well as adherence to PPE/hygiene policies, in accordance with company policy. 

Shift: Thursday to Sunday - 7:00pm to 5:30am

You will…

• Model proper sanitation and personal hygiene practices. 

• Oversees and performs typical sanitation tasks to support the production team and the entire facility up to and including removing waste and debris, transporting empty boxes to compactors, monitoring outside of facility for waste and debris, sanitizing equipment and floors at end of shifts, cleaning and sanitizing tools and receptacles and other custodial functions as needed.

• Coach employees on proper food waste practices to population in the building

• Enforce all policies and procedures

• Support the production department by cleaning and preparing for next shift 

• Required to communicate with all departments to collaborate and solve problems

• Responsible for promoting standard operating procedures (safety, GMP AND SQF policies /procedures, PPE / hygiene policies)

• Complete daily sanitation, safety and quality documents as needed

• Escalates all food safety and sanitation issues in a timely manner

You are….

• A leader fostering team cooperation for a large group of employees

• Agile and prioritize multiple assignments while meeting deadlines

• Able to adapt to Factor_ programs and procedure

• Versatile and able to step into function and assist team in a moments notice

You have….

• High School Diploma, or equivalent

• Ability to read, write, and speak English proficiently

• Previous food, grocery, or restaurant experience preferred, but not required

• Basic computer skills required

• Strong problem solving skills required

• Strong communication skills required

You’ll get…

• Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation

• Generous PTO and additional sick leave

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

• Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)  

• Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

• Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

 

Work Environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is in a manufacturing and assembly environment and is regularly exposed to cool and/or cold temperatures (10º - 40º). The employee is frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud.

title: Trust & Safety Specialist
description:
POWERING GREAT WORK

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone. Better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps, so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

Trust is at the heart of everything we do, and our Trust and Safety team plays a huge part in protecting it. As a Trust and Safety Specialist, you'll take ownership of more complex vetting cases, identify potential risks and help make sure the trades on our platform meet the standards homeowners expect. You'll also play a key role in supporting and developing the wider team, helping us continuously improve how we work.

THE JOB, UNFILTERED:

- Own the complex stuff. Independently manage end-to-end vetting for new and existing trade members, with a particular focus on higher-risk categories and more complicated case histories.

- Spot risks before they become problems. Monitor member activity, reviews, risk indicators and alerts to identify potential concerns and take appropriate action in line with our Trust and Safety policies.

- Make the right calls. Assess information objectively, exercise sound judgement and escalate concerns when needed, including recommending suspension or removal from the platform.

- Keep things clear and accurate. Maintain detailed, timely and well-structured case notes so decisions are easy to understand and colleagues can confidently pick up where you've left off.

- Know how to communicate. Choose the most effective way to engage with members and stakeholders, whether that's over the phone, in writing or through internal channels.

- Help others level up. Share your knowledge and coach junior colleagues across our UK and outsourced teams, helping improve quality and consistency.

- Be a go-to expert. Work closely with teams including Legal, Finance and Revenue Operations, providing guidance on vetting processes and more complex cases.

- Make things better. Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce inconsistencies and support changes that make our Trust and Safety function more effective.

- Protect sensitive information. Handle personal and confidential data responsibly, ensuring we're maintaining the highest standards of care and compliance.

THE FIT:

- Experience in vetting, compliance, risk, fraud prevention, Trust and Safety or a similar environment.

- Strong attention to detail, with the ability to assess complex information and make accurate, well-reasoned decisions.

- Confidence managing sensitive or high-risk cases independently, knowing when to escalate.

- Clear, concise communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities without compromising quality.

- A collaborative mindset and the confidence to share knowledge and support colleagues.

- Good IT skills and confidence working across different systems and tools.

- A genuine commitment to protecting customers, maintaining standards and doing the right thing.

- Experience working in a marketplace, membership-based business or regulated environment.

- Previous experience coaching, mentoring or supporting junior colleagues.

- Experience identifying process improvements or helping implement operational changes.

- Familiarity with risk monitoring, background checks or member verification processes.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

WHAT YOU GET

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Sch

Rubrik is looking for a Sales Engineer to provide technical direction and business guidance to our Enterprise sales team in Germany. • Strong sales engineering experience, ideally in a software or data centre environment; whether that's 5 years or 15, how you operate matters more than a specific number.

• Confidence running live, hands-on product demonstrations. This is a demo-led role, not a slideware one.

• A genuinely autonomous, self-starting approach: you'll own your patch and build your own path to success with your AEs and specialists, rather than work accounts handed down to you.

• A fundamental breadth of technical knowledge in cloud data management, backup and disaster recovery, and data analytics. Depth in one or two areas is great; you'll draw on internal specialists for the rest.

• Fluent German and business-proficient English. This role is customer-facing across the German enterprise market.

• Comfortable travelling within Germany for onsite customer meetings and workshops, and presenting confidently in person as well as on screen.

• A high level of business acumen and experience working with C-level personnel, bringing technology solutions to solve business challenges.

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in infrastructure, data centre technology, or cybersecurity. Rubrik 's SEs come from a range of starting points (infrastructure, cloud, security) and grow into the full platform from there, so this helps but isn't required.

title: Assistant Vice President.Retail Risk Analytics-Risk Management
description:
Key Result Areas

• Responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance of credit risk models and scorecards, including PD, LGD, and EAD across the retail portfolio lifecycle (acquisition, behavioral, collections).
• Lead the design and enhancement of credit risk modelling frameworks, incorporating scorecards and appropriate statistical/analytical techniques to support underwriting and portfolio management decisions.
• Monitor, document, and communicate the performance, assumptions, and limitations of credit risk models to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and model interpretability.
• Perform model monitoring, backtesting, and periodic recalibration, ensuring models remain accurate, stable, and compliant over time.
• Provide recommendations for model redevelopment or enhancement based on portfolio trends, data drift, and emerging risk patterns.
• Prepare and support Basel regulatory reporting, including RWA estimation and model-related submissions aligned with internal and regulatory requirements.
• Lead/support IFRS 9 ECL modelling, including staging, macroeconomic overlays, scenario-based expected credit loss estimation and stress testing including climate risk.
• Deploy credit risk models into production systems / rating platforms, working closely with IT and data teams to ensure data integrity and system robustness.
• Support design and implementation of credit risk strategies and decision rules (e.g., cut-offs, risk segmentation, line management) aligned with model outputs.
• Perform and oversee model validation and testing activities (functional, statistical, and regulatory) prior to deployment.
• Establish robust model governance practices, including documentation, audit trails, and compliance with regulatory standards.
• Identify opportunities to enhance credit risk models using advanced analytics or machine learning techniques, where appropriate and justifiable.
• Establish MLOps standards for model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and performance tracking in production environments.
• Develop data-driven insights to monitor portfolio quality, risk trends, and early warning indicators.
• Collaborate with policy, finance, and business teams to support portfolio optimization, provisioning, and capital management decisions.
• Ensure timely communication of model performance, validation findings, and risk insights to senior management and committees.
• Mentor junior analysts and contribute to building a strong, technically sound credit risk modelling team.

• Perform other duties as assigned.
Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships
Regular interaction and working relationship with:
• Retail Credit Policy

• Segment Heads - Business & Marketing
• Group Finance and CAD
• Credit Systems / IT / Data Teams
• Model Validation, Internal Audit, and Compliance
• Regulatory stakeholders (where required)
• Executive Management / Risk Committees

Problem Solving
Candidate must:

• Demonstrate strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills in credit risk modelling and portfolio analytics
• Possess deep understanding of credit scorecard development, validation techniques, and model risk management practices
• Have strong end-to-end experience in model development, validation, implementation, and performance monitoring
• Be able to diagnose model performance issues (e.g., drift, instability, segmentation breakdown) and recommend corrective actions
• Demonstrate technical proficiency in SAS, SQL, and Python/R, particularly in handling large datasets
• Exhibit strong stakeholder management skills and ability to communicate complex modelling concepts clearly
• Translate quantitative outputs into practical business and risk decisions

Decision Making Authority & Responsibility
• Responsible for ownership of credit risk models and scorecards across the retail portfolio
• Ensure models remain compliant with CBUAE Model Management Standards (MMS/MMG), IFRS 9, and Basel requirements

title: Part-Time Missouri Physician

Plume is a passion-fueled, mission-driven company that is trans-founded with a vision to transform healthcare for every trans life. We hope to make gender-affirming hormone therapy easily accessible at the touch of a button in every state of the US.
This work is deeply personal and heart-driven, and we want teammates who care about the mission and the people we serve. For the right candidates, we present a rare opportunity to do well by doing good. Plume offers an affirming, trans-centered, culturally inclusive, and fun work environment filled with purpose.
About the role:

Though this is a fully remote role, we are specifically seeking a Physician who is licensed and lives in Missouri.

As a part-time Physician with Plume , you will join our incredible team of diverse clinicians who provide GAHT (gender-affirming hormone therapy) and Expanded Clinical Services for our patients throughout the United States.

This is a part-time patient care position in which you will provide longitudinal care for a panel of patients. Your time will be spent onboarding new patients and providing follow-up care for them (lab management, prescription management, answering clinical questions). We have a large support team that takes care of patient account logistics so you can focus on clinical care.

• Experience and comfort collaborating with diverse teams

• Comfortable with 100% remote patient care

• Strong technical background (familiarity with EMRs, email communication, app-based platform use, etc.)

• Strong organization and communication skills

Nice-To-Have:

• Three or more state licenses

title: Software Engineer, Full Stack — Dots
description:
About the Team

Dots is building personal AI agents that help people make progress on their goals, including when they are away from ChatGPT. These agents can learn preferences, maintain context, work across applications, and use cloud computers to carry out tasks.

Our team brings together product engineering, design, and research to turn frontier model capabilities into useful everyday experiences. We are defining how people delegate work, understand what an agent is doing, and stay in control. Engineers help shape both the product and the systems behind it, from early prototypes through launch and iteration.

About the Role

We are looking for Senior and Staff Full Stack Software Engineers to build Dots product experiences from the interface through the services that power them. You will help define how people delegate tasks to personal agents, follow their progress, and collaborate with them over time. This role combines hands-on product development with the systems work needed to make persistent, asynchronous agent experiences reliable.

In this role, you will:

- Build and launch features across web interfaces, APIs, backend services, and data models.

- Create workflows for task creation, progress updates, agent feedback, and results that remain coherent across sessions and devices.

- Translate emerging model capabilities into product prototypes with research, product, and design partners.

- Design clear interfaces between product surfaces and agent execution systems.

- Improve performance and reliability across the stack, including user-facing latency and recovery from partial failures.

- Own projects from early exploration through architecture, implementation, launch, and iteration based on user feedback.

- Help establish technical direction, testing practices, and observability as the product grows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have significant experience building and shipping products across frontend and backend systems.

- Can move comfortably between user interfaces, service design, APIs, and data modeling.

- Bring strong product instincts and care about making complex capabilities understandable to users.

- Have taken ambiguous ideas from concept to production and made practical tradeoffs between iteration speed and long-term maintainability.

- Understand asynchronous workflows and can reason about state, consistency, and failure across system boundaries.

- Collaborate effectively with design, product, research, and engineering partners.

- Have owned complex engineering projects and helped other engineers make sound technical decisions.

- Experience launching new consumer products, building agent or workflow applications, or working in small teams with broad engineering ownership is especially relevant.

- Prior experience with AI or machine learning is helpful, but not required. We welcome experienced engineers who want to bring strong product and engineering judgment to a new category of software.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
